label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new Windows export tool likely encodes files with CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings. Since `parser.ts` splits by `\n` without stripping trailing carriage returns, the last field of every line retains a `\r`, making its length mismatch the header.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new Windows export tool likely encodes files with CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings. Since `parser.ts` splits by `\n` without stripping trailing carriage returns, the last field of every line retains a `\r`, making its length mismatch the header.
